metadata.description: AI agent skills for the designer's craft. Brand diagnosis and audit, brand strategy, creative direction, art direction, logo design, and application across web, collateral, motion, and product film — with a shared context document so you never re-explain your brand.

plugins.name: designskills
plugins.description: 11 skills that give an agent real design competency. Foundation (brand / design-principles), strategy (brand-strategy), identity (creative-direction / art-direction / logo-design), system (design-system), application (web-design / collateral-design / motion-design / product-film). Reads and writes a shared brand context in .agents/. Sibling to makerskills and marketingskills.
